name: Ghost Sweet as Sugar
source:
Penny Bun has just moved to a new apartment, but it soon becomes clear to her that the rent was cheap for a reason: The place is haunted! But little does she know what the ghost really wants of her...

[From [url=https://lezliz.itch.io/ghost-sweet-as-sugar]itch.io[/url]]
